capabilities: Display favicons next to note titles in the file tree
Read a favicon URL from a note's frontmatter field
Accept base64-encoded images embedded in frontmatter
Fetch favicons from Google's favicon service and cache them
Update icons in real time as frontmatter changes
extras: Not yet available in Obsidian's community plugin store; must be installed from GitHub releases. Sends URL domains to Google's favicon service (external requests with privacy implications) unless base64 images are used instead; favicons are cached to reduce requests.
problem: Obsidian's file tree shows plain file names, so notes are hard to visually distinguish at a glance.
summary: Favicon display plugin that shows an icon next to note titles in the file tree, based on a URL or base64 image in frontmatter.
